move: flat face morphs eyes, mouth and head through happy, surprised, wink, neutral
how: A black circle head with yellow eyes, brows and mouth on a yellow square. At 0.05D, 0.3D, 0.55D and 0.8D the eye, mouth and head paths morphSVG to the next expression over 0.32s (power3.inOut; head with back.out(2)), brows translate and rotate, blush fades in or out, and the caption drops out (yPercent 120, 0.14s power2.in), swaps text in a callback, and falls in from -120 (expo.out). The face bobs y 0 to -10 and the eyes look side to side on 0.75s sine yoyos, and the surprise state adds a jump: y -40 in 0.18s then bounce.out back. The last state returns to neutral so the loop closes.
adapt: Replace the head/eye/mouth colours and the four labels; add or reorder expressions in the EYE/MOUTH/HEAD dictionaries; keep the 0.32s morph, the 0.75s state spacing and the bob yoyo.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the inline SVG and .label into el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with state times at 0.05D/0.3D/0.55D/0.8D. Scope '#eyeL' etc. to el (use el.querySelector) since ids are document-level.
caveats: label text is swapped in tl.add callbacks, so a backwards scrub does not restore the previous word
